sources.title: Decrypt / Chainwire (sponsored) — Momentum raises strategic round led by OKX Ventures, Coinbase Ventures, Protagonist and DNA Fund (2025-06-05)
sources.excerpt: Strategic round at a $100M valuation (amount undisclosed), led by OKX Ventures with Coinbase Ventures, Gate, MEXC and KuCoin Ventures; prior $10M round led by Varys Capital (Mar 2025). Claims $3B swap volume and $69M TVL per DefiLlama, 420k+ users in two months. Co-founder ChefWEN, MSafe architect and senior engineer on Meta's Libra. Says contracts are 'audited' without naming an auditor. San Francisco dateline.

sources.title: The Block — Aptos-based multisig wallet MSafe raises $5 million led by Jump Crypto (2023-01-05)
sources.excerpt: $5M seed (SAFE plus token warrant) led by Jump Crypto with Superscrypt, Circle Ventures, Coinbase Ventures, Shima. CEO Wendy Fu, formerly a software engineer on Meta's Novi wallet; CTO Jacky Wang, formerly a developer at Harmony. Company founded July 2022.

sources.title: Crypto-Fundraising.info — Momentum (MSafe) funding rounds (rounds dated up to Oct 2025 only)
sources.excerpt: Jan 2023 seed $5M led by Jump Crypto (Circle, Coinbase Ventures, Redpoint, SV Angel, Spartan…); Mar 2025 strategic $5M led by Varys Capital (Coinbase Ventures, Circle, Jump, Aptos, Amber, Selini, Sui Foundation…); Jun 2025 strategic at $100M valuation led by OKX Ventures; Oct 2025 public sale $4.5M.

sources.title: IQ.wiki — Wendy Fu (live wiki page; only pre-Nov-2025 career facts used)
sources.excerpt: Zhejiang University BEng; AWS EC2 internship 2016; Facebook software engineer from 2017, later senior engineer on Libra; founded Momentum Aug 2022, focused on Sui and Move.

active_enforcement_action.note: No enforcement action, lawsuit or regulator warning against Momentum, RIZE Labs or Wendy Fu found in press searches, and none in the Coinone listing filing. SEC/CFTC/FCA/MAS and Panama registers were NOT queried directly; confirm before committee
